wording_corrections.new: Selected independent task: the supplied three-star count and above-triangle relation pass; the circle crossing the rectangle edge violates full containment. Fresh retry: two books are below a shelf while a cup overlaps a tray edge; the brief requires two books above the shelf and the cup fully inside the tray. Count passes; both position and containment fail. Record support and collect the first attempt before feedback. The earlier two-arrow provenance task remains additional practice.
